operating_notes.text: Total ECL provision at 31 March 2026 was ₹3,935.92 Cr, including ₹852 Cr of management overlay created during FY26.
Capital adequacy ratio stood at 18.84% at 31 March 2026 versus 18.33% a year earlier.
The company transferred one stressed loan with ₹18.02 Cr principal outstanding to an ARC for ₹9.46 Cr consideration during the quarter ended December 2025.
LIC held 14,26,25,702 equity shares, 10.26% of paid-up capital, as on 31 March 2026.
28 April 2026: ₹500 Cr of Series AA2026 NCDs allotted at a fixed 7.71% coupon, issued at par and proposed for listing on BSE's Wholesale Debt Market segment.
Management created an overarching macroeconomic overlay provision of INR 217 crores in Q4 FY26.
7 May 2026: Series AB2026 NCDs carry a 7.90% fixed coupon, 19 bps above the 7.71% on the April 2026 Series AA2026 issue.
7 May 2026: Series AB2026 issue is up to ₹1,000 Cr (base ₹750 Cr plus ₹250 Cr green shoe), secured by exclusive charge on loan/hire-purchase/lease receivables and book debts to 100% of outstanding.
12 May 2026: Series AB2026 NCDs allotted at a 7.90% fixed coupon, ₹875 Cr total (₹750 Cr base plus ₹125 Cr green shoe), issued at par and proposed for listing on BSE's Wholesale Debt Market segment.
22 May 2026: CRISIL reaffirmed AAA/Stable on ₹30,980 Cr NCDs, ₹6,000.5 Cr subordinated debt, ₹20,000 Cr fixed deposits and ₹20,000 Cr bank facilities, and A1+ on ₹20,000 Cr commercial paper.
100% of wheels disbursements, close to ₹15,000 Cr in Q1, ran on the Udaan digital stack.
AI agent Samur.AI covers 45% of CPC operations, up from 20%, and AI vernacular bot coverage is 20%.
Share of M&M group business in total assets is 46%, across PV, CV, tractor and 3-wheeler.

timeline.summary: M&M Financial Services received credit rating reaffirmations and facility enhancements from India Ratings, CARE, and CRISIL.
22 April 2026: CRISIL reaffirmed all ratings and enhanced rated facilities for M&MFIN
23 April 2026: Board committee approves ₹1,000 Cr NCD issuance at 7.71% p.a.
24 April 2026: Board approved audited Q4/FY26 results — standalone PAT ₹873 Cr in Q4; FY26 ₹2,782 Cr; dividend of ₹7.50/share recommended.

24 April 2026: Board approved raising the Section 180(1)(c) borrowing limit from ₹1,50,000 Cr to ₹1,75,000 Cr (subject to AGM approval), kept the NCD sub-limit at ₹65,000 Cr, and proposed LIC nominee Krishna Kumar Sukumaran Nair as director from 23 June 2026.
28 April 2026: Debenture Allotment Committee allotted 50,000 NCDs (Series AA2026) at 7.71% coupon, raising ₹500 Cr on private placement.
M&M Financial Services held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on April 24, 2026, reporting a 55% YoY jump in Q4 PAT.
12 May 2026: Debenture Allotment Committee allotted 87,500 Series AB2026 NCDs at a 7.90% coupon, raising ₹875 Cr (₹750 Cr base plus ₹125 Cr green shoe).

22 May 2026: CRISIL and India Ratings reaffirmed M&M Financial's ratings — CRISIL AAA/Stable and A1+, IND AAA/Stable and IND A1+ — across NCDs, sub-debt, commercial paper, bank loans and fixed deposits.

Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited schedules Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with **Raul Rebello** (MD & CEO) and **Pradeep Agrawal** (CFO) on **21 October 2026 at 18:30 IST** via dial-in.
On October 21, 2026, Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services reported Q2FY27 standalone revenue of ₹5,163.51 Cr and net profit of ₹881.52 Cr.
Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services reported Q2FY27 standalone PAT of ₹882 Cr, up 55% YoY, with AUM growing 15% to ₹1,46,512 Cr.
Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited uploaded Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings call audio on 21st October 2026 via **Brijbala Batwal, FCS: 5220** at 7:43 p.m. IST.
